messages:
Aisha P: FYI onboarding customer Delta LoRA (umbraflux-cust) — quick smoke shows amounts dropping cents in ~20% of cases. evalpack uploaded: cust-delta-invoice-quick.json :link:
Noah L: can you paste failing prompt id and an example output?
Aisha P: prompt 0049: 'Invoice total: $4,210.50' model -> '4210' (no .50). Happens on long context only.
Ravi: suspect tokenizer id mismatch. Did their finetune use a custom tokenizer?
Aisha P: yes, finetune used cust_delta_tok_v2 but we applied LoRA against umbrafux-base tokenizer.
Noah L: quick diff command: `tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v2.json`
Noah L: diff snippet: `- \".\": 56  + \".\": 512` — punctuation ids shifted.
Ravi: that'll redirect embedding indices; LoRA patch will be misaligned. Try remapping LoRA token ids to cust tokenizer and rerun before quantizing.
Aisha P: there's a script `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py --target customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v2.json` I can run.
EvalBot: quick-eval queued (job ej-99300) on test-gpu-2.
Ravi: run three variants: fp16 baseline, int4 without remap, int4 with remap.
EvalBot: job complete. results: fp16 cents preserved 99.0%, int4 w/o remap 71.8%, int4 with remap 95.9%. logs: /mnt/results/ej-99300/summary.json
Aisha P: clear signal. I'll add automatic tokenmap diff + remap step to the onboarding pipeline and document it.
Noah L: add a smoke test asserting currency cents preserved. small PR ok.
